title: R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo)
caption: R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (V)
game_text: Your capital starships are deploy -1 and are destiny +2 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny. Once per game, Shawn Valdez may deploy for free to same site.
lore: Programmed to pilot sublight tactical courses. R5 units are in high demand for combat starships. R5-M2 helped plan evacuation routes from Echo Base. Owned by Shawn Valdez.

notes: Non-unique. Two stat boxes (POWER 1, ASTROMECH DROID label). Icon column: one red square with a green astromech dome = astromech; the printed Hoth card has no icon in its column (the wiki's 'Nav Computer' is a characteristic), so the slip adds it. Deploy 1 / forfeit 3 as printed on the slip (same as base). Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Modern: VB2 only (-pre used; non-pre also downloaded). Copyright 1996 (Hoth), not legible.
